From the website: keep orthodoxdaily.net on your phone's home screen, like an app.

orthodoxdaily.net can be added to your home screen. It then opens from its own icon, like an app.

On iPhone, in Safari: tap the share button at the top right, then View More, then Add to Home Screen.

On Android, in Chrome: tap the three-dot menu at the top right, then Add to Home screen (some phones say Install app).

Full day at the link in our bio.
